scientific_integrity: Direct infinite proof and independent finite arithmetic tests; self-review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Explicit formulas are proved only for h>=4, a>=(h-3)(h^2-h+1)+h+1, unit shift and three generators.
A boundary counterexample proves sharpness of the uniform threshold but not failure at every smaller a.
Broader general three-generator algorithms may imply the formulas after nontrivial specialization; specialist originality review remains appropriate.
title: Sharp greedy Apéry threshold and symmetry dichotomy in a three-generator \(h\)-ary family
